question: Train a logistic regression model on gene expression data to predict cancer vs. normal tissue samples using a 70/30 train-test split. Extract and return the top 10 most important genes (by absolute coefficient magnitude) and report test accuracy.

expected_output.guidelines: The reported test accuracy value must match the reference within +/-0.02; column labels and row order may differ.

At least 7 of the 10 reported genes must overlap with the reference set (gene rankings near rank 10 are sensitive to solver version); coefficient values for overlapping genes within +/-0.05; column naming and ordering may differ.
